## Progression and rewards

> [!NOTE]
> Everything in this section is a deliberate departure from the official game, not a restoration of it. The realm reopens Legion tier by tier, and these settings exist to make that pacing hold.

- **[Change]** Config/Patch: `Game.Patch` takes one value per Legion patch (7.0 to 7.3) instead of three.
- **[Change]** Core/Items: item levels are pinned server-side instead of read from the client: dungeons at 805 / 825 / 840 for the whole expansion, raids attached to their own map, Karazhan per boss.
  > The client's DB2 data holds the 7.3.5 catch-up values, which were inflated at the end of the expansion to let latecomers skip ahead. Using them made a normal dungeon out-reward the first raid.
- **[Change]** Core/Mythic+: loot follows the key up to +25, where the original game stopped at +15. It stays capped by the heroic raid of the open tier, so a high key never out-rewards unreleased content.
- **[Change]** Core/Mythic+: creature scaling is computed from two tunable slopes instead of the client tables: 8% per key up to +15, 5% above. A +15 is worth 2.72x and a +25 4.43x.
  > The client's own tables would put that same +25 at 9.85x: they rise by 10% compounded per key and never flatten.
- **[Change]** Core/Artifacts: Artifact Knowledge advances per character through the class hall order again, capped by tier (25 / 40 / 55).
  > The realm used the late 7.3 design: one world state bumped weekly and forced onto every character at login, which leaves no individual progression at all.
- **[Change]** Core/Artifacts: a Knowledge book drops from current-tier raids, the Mythic+ chest and PvP chests: free-for-all, one per player per week. Off by default.
- **[Change]** Core/Artifacts: a catch-up quest rerolls an alt to rank 10, gated on a new account-wide condition type.
- **[Change]** Core/Items: the weekly chest has its own item level cap.
- **[Change]** Core/Items: the per-tier item level penalty that still applied to dungeon loot is gone, now that dungeon levels are pinned.
- **[Change]** Config/Legion: Legion Assaults and the pre-patch invasions get their own options, independent of the patch level.

## Combat and classes

- **[Change]** Core/Combat: damage variance system carried over from 9.x. Minimum and maximum damage are computed from a variance that falls back to 0.3466 when the client data is missing or zero, and every hit swings 5% either way.
  > `Damage.Variance.Pct` sets the spread, and 0 makes every hit deterministic again. It sits on top of the weapon's own min/max damage, which only spreads weapon swings.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Spells: Warlock Dreadstalkers land on opposite flanks of the target instead of stacking on each other.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Spells: Hand of Gul'dan drops its Wild Imps next to the caster rather than at the target.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Spells: Warlock Vilefiend summons no longer overlap their caster.
- **[Fix]** Hotfixes/Spells: Doom Bolt can be cast at all: the Doomguard was charged Energy it does not have, having only a mana bar, so the cost is hotfixed to zero.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Spells: Cripple stops being cast on targets already in melee range, and on the elites and bosses that are immune to it.

## Pets and creatures

- **[Fix]** Core/Pets: loading a pet matched on creature id instead of pet number, so a player with two pets of the same kind could get the wrong one back.
- **[Fix]** Core/Pets: a pet keeps its own follow distance and angle when leaving combat instead of snapping back to the hardcoded pair.
- **[Change]** Core/Pets: the default pet follow distance goes from 1 to 2 yards.
- **[Fix]** Core/Creatures: a creature's channelled spell starts its cooldown when the channel ends, not when it begins.
- **[Fix]** Core/Creatures: elite, rare and boss creatures hit as hard as they should.
  > The damage modifier was missing from the base formula while the health one was applied, so they had the expected health and hit like a regular mob.
- **[Fix]** Core/Creatures: every creature with both scaling bounds left at zero died to its first hit.
- **[Fix]** Core/Movement: waypoint movement starts at once and no longer stalls between points.
- **[Fix]** Core/Movement: a creature holds still while a player is talking to it.
- **[Fix]** DB/Creatures: Rukhmar patrols low enough to be fought from the Skyreach platform.

## Items and inventory

- **[Fix]** Core/Items: artifact research notes restored: both work, refresh the artifact window, and consume the note actually clicked.
  > 7.3 emptied both items when Knowledge became automatic: the use effect stripped, the text replaced by one saying they were obsolete. Neither had an `ItemEffect` entry left, so the whole research loop had been dead, hidden by the weekly increment.
- **[Fix]** Hotfixes/Spells: spell 235765, dropped from `Spell.db2` in 7.3, restored by hotfix in English and French.
  > Its mechanics survived elsewhere, so the item worked, but with no text the client drew no "Use:" line, and therefore never sent the use packet.
- **[Fix]** Core/Items: bag filters work. The opcodes were unhandled and the backpack's own one undeclared.
- **[Fix]** Core/Items: bank bag filters and the auto-sort checkboxes work (three more unhandled opcodes).
- **[Fix]** Core/Items: cleanup sorting repeats until nothing moves, so one Clean Up is enough.
- **[Fix]** Core/Items: bank and reagent bank sorting return a result instead of stopping early.
- **[Fix]** Core/Commands: `.additem` honours the difficulty picked in the adventure guide.
- **[Change]** Core/AuctionHouse: the auction house bot is removed entirely: sources, hooks, table and 390 lines of config.

## Social

- **[Change]** Core/RAF: Recruit-A-Friend is answered with `.account raf list / accept / refuse` or over an addon chat prefix for a client-side interface, and announced in chat at every login until answered.
- **[Change]** Core/RAF: the bonus is a flat +50% to experience and reputation, replacing the two configurable rates, and adds to rested experience instead of replacing it.
  > Another deliberate departure. Replacing rested experience made the bonus a net loss for a rested player.
- **[Fix]** Core/Characters: deleted characters can be restored. The list showed the character's live name instead of the one recorded at deletion, and its level came from a cache that could be stale.

## Calendar

- **[Change]** Core/Calendar: content openings are announced from one world table: a name, a date, `Enabled` set to 1.
  > The client only draws holidays, read from its own files. A scheduled opening sent as a calendar event shows up as a player event authored by "Unknown", so the core translates the table into the holiday hotfixes the client does read.
- **[Change]** DB/Calendar: the 21 Legion openings are already in the table: every raid wing, the 7.2 and 7.3 dungeons, Broken Shore, Argus, the demon invasion. Nothing to create: fill in a date, set `Enabled` to 1.
- **[Change]** Core/Calendar: announcements can repeat, up to ten occurrences, and can drive a game event.
- **[Fix]** Core/Calendar: `HolidayDescriptions` is loaded. The store was commented out, so no holiday description ever reached the client.

## Security and anticheat

- **[Exploit]** Core/Calendar: guildless players no longer see each other's private calendar events.
- **[Exploit]** Core/Calendar: editing and deleting a calendar event now check ownership; neither checked anything at all.
  > An event id is a plain number the client sends, so any player could alter or wipe any other player's event, invitation mail included.
- **[Change]** Core/Anticheat: dry run mode, on by default, plus configurable thresholds and a staff exemption.
  > Detections were acted on immediately against hardcoded margins, so a lift, a fall or a lag spike could kick a legitimate player, and `.mod speed` is indistinguishable from a speed hack.
- **[Fix]** Core/Anticheat: `outAnticheat` was an empty stub, so every detection was written nowhere.

## World and content

- **[Change]** Config/World: Argus is drawn in the sky. Off by default (`Custom.ArgusInSky.Enable`).
  > The client draws a celestial body from `MapCelestialBody` but never evaluates that table on its own: `SMSG_UPDATE_CELESTIAL_BODY` is the signal, and the core never sent it.
- **[Fix]** DB/Silithus: Zidormi's timeline switch works.
- **[Fix]** DB/Silithus: the Wound is reachable without the Antorus questline.
- **[Fix]** Core/Legion Assaults: assault bonus objectives show on the map again.
  > The client hid them because of a `PlayerCondition` shipped in DB2 that a private realm cannot satisfy.
- **[Fix]** Core/World quests: expired world quests stop being sent to the client; their states were never cleaned up once they expired.
- **[Change]** Core/Commands: a command forces an assault into a chosen zone.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Invasions: the pre-patch demon invasion reaches its fourth phase, with the Nethershard vendor, experience, achievements and progress tracking.
- **[Fix]** Core/Adventure Guide: adventure map objectives are added and completed on their own, while journal entries open the quest and wait for the player to accept it.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Brawler's Guild: queues again; both faction handlers were unscripted, and two creatures had no AI attached.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Blasted Lands: the Iron Demolisher aims, fires and can be destroyed, with the missile speed and damage it should have.
- **[Change]** DB/GameObjects: `gameobject_template.VisibilityDistance`, a sight range an object carries on its own.
- **[Fix]** DB/Phases: Dark Portal introduction scenario, replacing 45 `phase_definitions` rows.
- **[Fix]** Core/Visibility: objects are visible immediately on entering a map, instead of arriving after a distance delay.
  > That delay dropped the player into the void for a second after the loading screen.
- **[Fix]** Core/Phasing: a phase-neutral object is visible to everyone, instead of hidden from anything carrying a phase.

## Stability

- **[Crash]** Core/Maps: `UpdateTargetMap`, on an iterator its own loop had invalidated.
- **[Crash]** Core/Loot: rolling loot from a creature that had despawned.
- **[Crash]** Core/Pets: naming a pet with no creature template.
- **[Crash]** Scripts/Brawler's Guild: ranks 2, 3, 5 and 6 dereferenced owners, creatures and spell entries without checking any of them.
- **[Fix]** Core/Artifacts: relic talent tiers read past the end when a tier is empty.
- **[Data loss]** Core/Artifacts: artifact power above 4 294 967 295 lost to a 32-bit read of a 64-bit field.
- **[Memory leak]** Core/AuctionHouse: the entry was kept when the item could not be created.
- **[Memory leak]** Scripts/Blackwing Lair: Nefarian never released his object list.
- **[Memory leak]** Scripts/Dark Portal: the two greeters recorded every player they had spoken to and never dropped an entry, not even on reset.
- **[Fix]** Core/Localization: creature, item and quest names written twice through UTF-8 encoding.
- **[Fix]** Core/Logging: exceptions swallowed by the map loops were written nowhere, and so were tick timings (both were empty stubs). Exceptions now log at ERROR, which the root logger carries without any configuration; timings go to a `diff` filter.
- **[Fix]** Core/Logging: phase recalculation logged under the wrong category.
- **[Change]** Core/Logging: time sync acks and unimplemented protobuf calls drop from ERROR to DEBUG, as both are normal traffic.
- **[Fix]** Core/Network: four client messages become authenticated no-ops instead of unhandled.
- **[Change]** Core/Logging: the `DAMAGE_BUG` diagnostic drops from error to debug, so it stops hitting the disk on every low-damage hit.

## Performance

- **[Change]** Core/Network: the send buffer is only built when there is something to send, instead of being zeroed for every player every millisecond, almost always for an empty queue.
- **[Change]** Core/Maps: `Map.NumThreads` at 1 runs inline, instead of paying the queue handoff and the condition variable wait for a single worker that brings no parallelism.
- **[Change]** Core/Maps: an instanceable map with no instance idles instead of spinning for the rest of the uptime.
- **[Change]** Core/Creatures: creatures keep their ground height until they move, instead of walking two spatial trees every update.
- **[Change]** Core/Creatures: creature spell lists become a vector; 100k templates paid for a bucket array to hold 8 spells.
- **[Change]** Core/Maps: map lookups move to unordered containers, and the pull cell size is read once rather than on every pull.
- **[Fix]** Core/Pathfinding: navigation queries get twice the node budget.
- **[Fix]** Core/Pathfinding: a unit standing above the navmesh, on a moving object for instance, is snapped onto the nearest polygon before the path is built.
  > Starting from the wrong polygon produced a path through the floor.

## Data and technical

- **[Fix]** DB/Localization: French names for creatures, items and quests.
- **[Change]** DB/Updates: 328 applied SQL files archived rather than deleted.
  > A row in the `updates` table with no file behind it is a dead reference, and the server stops starting past three of them.
- **[Fix]** DB/Misc: about a thousand rows of database errors fixed, over several passes.
- **[Fix]** Core/Build: the core and the scripts compile without warnings, across some 150 files (double-to-float truncations, C-style casts, signed and unsigned comparisons). No behaviour was changed.
- **[Fix]** Core/Movement: GM flight survives a logout.
- **[Change]** Core/Scripts: quest accept and abandon hooks for scripts.
- **[Change]** Core/Misc: SoloCraft is removed.
- **[Change]** DB/Quests: the 6.0.2 Iron Horde invasion quests are disabled.

## Tools

- **[Change]** Tools/Maps: model conversion runs on every core instead of one.
- **[Fix]** Tools/Extractors: the extractors try each locale until one has readable DB2 files, rather than giving up on the first.
- **[Change]** Tools/Extractors: they print the path they are reading and wait before closing, so a double-click is enough to see what happened.
- **[Fix]** Tools/Extractors: all three extractors failed on a working directory with no `ClientData` yet.

## Known limitations

- **[Change]** Core/Store: BattlePay and the WoW Token are present but unfinished; the Token is missing opcodes and ships disabled.
- **[Change]** Scripts/Spires of Arak: the Solar Skyreach event is a work in progress.
- **[Change]** Config/Calendar: announcements ship disabled and undated, and opening a date does not open the content it announces; the config option has to follow, with `.reload config`.
- **[Change]** DB/Calendar: most announcement icons are one image repeated three times instead of a start / ongoing / end triptych.
- **[Change]** Config/Anticheat: anticheat defaults to dry run: nothing is punished until the log has been read against real play.
- **[Change]** Config/Legion: `Custom.ArgusInSky.Enable` and the Knowledge book loot default to off.

## Content tiers

> [!NOTE]
> A tier script only runs when the tier changes, not at every startup. Each file runs in a transaction: if it fails, the database stays as it was and the server stops.

- **[Change]** Config/Game.Patch: `Game.Patch` now opens and closes content by itself. At startup, for each tier (7.1, 7.1.5, 7.2, 7.3), the server compares `Game.Patch` with the world database and runs the matching `enable` or `disable` script of `sql/optional` when they no longer match.
- **[Change]** DB/Optional: new 7.1 and 7.1.5 scripts, on the model of 7.2 and 7.3. The 7.1 script closes Return to Karazhan, the first quests of the Suramar Insurrection chapter, of the Karazhan attunement and of the Trial of Valor introduction.
- **[Change]** DB/Optional: the 7.1.5 script closes Boon of the Builder<del class="reverted" data-en="Reverted in a later update: the micro-holidays and Mists of Pandaria Timewalking run whatever Game.Patch says." data-fr="Annulé dans une mise à jour suivante : les micro-fêtes et la marche du temps de Pandarie tournent quel que soit Game.Patch.">, the micro-holidays (Hatching of the Hippogryphs, Volunteer Guard Day, Call of the Scarab, Kirin Tor Tavern Crawl, Spring Balloon Festival, Glowcap Festival, March of the Tadpoles, Thousand Boat Bash) and Mists of Pandaria Timewalking</del>.
- **[Change]** Core/Game: a player logging in inside closed content (Argus below 7.3, the Broken Shore below 7.2, a map closed as a whole) is sent to Stormwind or Orgrimmar. GMs are not affected.
- **[Change]** DB/Optional: the 7.2 and 7.3 scripts no longer touch Tomb of Sargeras and Antorus; raids only follow the new raid settings below.
- **[Fix]** DB/Optional: the 7.3 script restored the Argus invasion times two hours off those of the database; closing then opening the tier now changes nothing.

## Raids

- **[Change]** Config/Raid opening: new `RAID OPENING` section in `worldserver.conf`, with one switch per difficulty and per Raid Finder wing for the five Legion raids, such as `Raid.EmeraldNightmare.LFR.Wing1 = 1`. Open by default, and independent from `Game.Patch`.
- **[Change]** Core/Disables: the flags of `disables` map rows now list the closed difficulties instead of being ignored.
- **[Change]** Core/Disables: a single Raid Finder wing is closed with an LFG row (`sourceType` 8).
  > The `.conf` and the table add up: a raid is closed as soon as either one closes it.
- **[Change]** Core/Disables: players already inside a closed raid keep playing and GM accounts pass. A closed difficulty shows the client's "difficulty mode is not available" message, and the group finder shows closed wings as temporarily disabled.

## Mail, guild and battlegrounds

- **[Exploit]** Core/Mail: cash on delivery above 214,748 gold was cast to 32 bits, so the recipient gained gold instead of paying, which let two players create gold.
- **[Fix]** Core/Mail: mail money and cash on delivery were saved on 32 bits when a mail changed state; a 500,000 gold mail came back as about 70,500 gold.
- **[Fix]** Core/Guild: the guild bank money log showed amounts above 429,496 gold wrong; the balance itself was right.
- **[Fix]** Core/Battlegrounds: after a relog inside a battleground, leaving it gave back the wrong mount (most Legion mounts did not fit in 16 bits).
- **[Fix]** Core/Battlegrounds: after a relog inside a battleground, leaving it failed to restore the specialization of priests, rogues, shamans, warlocks, monks and demon hunters.
- **[Fix]** Core/Summons: the free summon slot search read and wrote one slot past the end of the array when every slot was taken.

## GM commands

### Crashes

- **[Crash]** Core/Commands: `.npc flags` crashed the server on every use.
- **[Crash]** Core/Commands: a timed `.ban`, `.mute` and `.unmute` crashed the server when typed from the console.

- **[Fix]** DB/Texts: ten missing texts are added (`.list mail`, `.account create`, GM notices for mutes and bans); they showed `<error>`.

## Mythic+

> [!NOTE]
> Most of this section brings Mythic+ back in line with the official game. What departs from it on purpose is tagged **Change**.

### Keys and difficulty

- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: creature scaling counted one key level short of retail (a +2 was worth 1.00x instead of 1.08x); a +N key is now worth `(1 + slope)^(N-1)`, which gives back the 7.0 values: 2.00x at +10, 2.94x at +15.
- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: the move from 8% to 10% per level happened in 7.2.5, not in 7.3; the documentation now says so.
- **[Fix]** Config/Challenge: keys stop at +25; `Challenge.LevelLimit` defaulted to 30, so keys +26 to +30 were harder for the same loot.
- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: keys only draw the dungeons of the open content tier (Karazhan and Cathedral of Eternal Night join in 7.2, Seat of the Triumvirate in 7.3).
- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: a failed run no longer loops until it draws another dungeon.

### Rewards

- **[Change]** Core/Challenge: linear item level curve, the original pace up to +8, then 5 item levels per key up to 945 at +25.
  > The old curve sped up at the top (2.5, then 5, then 9 per key).
- **[Change]** Core/Challenge: the weekly chest gives 5 item levels above the end-of-run loot and is capped at heroic raid + 5 (950 at Antorus), 10 below the mythic raid.
- **[Change]** Config/Challenge: one setting per content tier, `ItemLevel.MythicPlus.Cap`; the weekly chest cap and the highest key follow from it.
  > Tiers as end of run / weekly chest / highest key: 7.0 865 / 870 / +10; 7.1 875 / 880 / +11; 7.1.5 890 / 895 / +15; 7.2 915 / 920 / +20; 7.3 945 / 950 / +25.
- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: end-of-run chest as in 7.2.5, 2 items, 3 in time, plus 40% more per key level above +15; extra items started above +10, which gave 9 items at +25 instead of 7.
- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: saved affixes were all written to the first slot.
- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: the weekly chest level is bounded by its reward tables.
- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: records keep the key level and are looked up by challenge id.

### Weekly reset

- **[Change]** Core/Challenge: keys decay instead of vanishing; at the weekly reset the next key is the best key of the week minus one, or the last level minus two without a completed key, never below +2.
- **[Change]** Core/Challenge: the class hall chest hands the key back to any player without one, with no gear when no key was completed.
- **[Fix]** Core/Challenge: the key row of the past week survived the reset, so offline players could not loot a key at the end of a mythic dungeon.

## Raids

- **[Fix]** DB/Loot: Trial of Valor item levels (LFR / N / H / M) now 845 / 860 / 875 / 890, were 840 / 855 / 870 / 885, matching the client's item level selectors shown by the Adventure Guide.
- **[Fix]** DB/Loot: The Nighthold item levels (LFR / N / H / M) now 860 / 875 / 890 / 905, were 845 / 875 / 890 / 905, matching the client's item level selectors.
- **[Fix]** DB/Loot: Tomb of Sargeras item levels, Kil'jaeden +10, matching the client's item level selectors.
- **[Fix]** DB/Loot: Antorus, the Burning Throne item levels, Argus +10, matching the client's item level selectors.
- **[Fix]** DB/Loot: the Knowledge book (+1 Artifact Knowledge rank) now drops by default, one per player and per week, from raid bosses, PvP victory chests and both Mythic+ chests.
  > Its Mythic+ entry sat in a loot table that was never read, so it had never dropped.

## Battlegrounds and arenas

### Battlegrounds

- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Warsong Gulch and Twin Peaks, a player standing in the capture area blocked the flag carrier.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Warsong Gulch, Twin Peaks and Eye of the Storm, a refused click on a dropped flag deleted it.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: premature ends gave ties to the Alliance; Alterac Valley and Isle of Conquest now compare the reinforcements left.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Arathi Basin and Battle for Gilneas, defending a contested node kept its assault timer, which captured the node a second time.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Isle of Conquest, re-assaulting a node now starts the clicking team's own countdown.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Alterac Valley, the 5 minute first capture applied to every node instead of neutral Snowfall only.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Alterac Valley, end reputation was never given.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Alterac Valley, surviving towers counted for the Alliance only.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Warsong Gulch showed 10 captures to win instead of 3.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Seething Shore, a gunship was created on every teleport.
- **[Fix]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Seething Shore, a node could score twice in one update.
- **[Crash]** Scripts/Battlegrounds: Seething Shore, the fissure loop could hang.

### Rated arenas

- **[Fix]** Core/Arenas: the 25 minute rule compared the wrong counts.
